question: How many factors of 2⁷ × 3³ × 5⁴ × 7 are even numbers?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify exponents of **prime factorization**: 2⁷, 3³, 5⁴, and 7¹.

For even factors, use formula: **(exponent of 2) × (exponent of 3 + 1) × (exponent of 5 + 1) × (exponent of 7 + 1)**.

Even factors = 7 × (3 + 1) × (4 + 1) × (1 + 1)

Even factors = 7 × 4 × 5 × 2 = 280.

**∴ The correct answer is 280.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** N = 2⁷ × 3³ × 5⁴ × 7¹

**Formula:** Even Factors = **Total Factors** − **Odd Factors**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77a7e652e0c7623cba9b2a67cee718341cc9a9e3b86f2bc0354526d7d3d18fed.png] 

⇒ Total Factors = (7 + 1) × (3 + 1) × (4 + 1) × (1 + 1)

⇒ Total Factors = 8 × 4 × 5 × 2 = 320

⇒ Odd Factors (set exponent of 2 to 0) = 1 × (3 + 1) × (4 + 1) × (1 + 1)

⇒ Odd Factors = 4 × 5 × 2 = 40

⇒ Even Factors = 320 − 40 = 280

Comparing this result with the given options, the number of even factors is 280, which is Option (3).

**∴ The correct answer is 280.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Number of Factors

For any number N = pa × qb × rc, total factors = (a + 1)(b + 1)(c + 1).

Odd and Even Factors

Even factors must have 2x where x ≥ 1. Odd factors only contain powers of odd prime numbers (3, 5, 7, etc.).

Sum of Factors

The sum of factors is given by [(pa⁺¹ − 1)/(p − 1)] × [(qb⁺¹ − 1)/(q − 1)] × ...

Product of Factors

The product of all factors of a number N is N⁽Total Factors / ²⁾.
